Peacock had married on 22 March 1820 in Cardiganshire, having proposed to her in November 1819
but neither seen nor written to her since April 1811. Peacock had met her in 1810 and referred to her
then as ‘The Caernavonshire nymph’, though in fact her father, John Gryffydh, was rector of Festiniog
and Maentwrog, Merionethshire (Peacock L i 52, 170). News of his marriage had reached the Shelleys
by 21 April (Claire Jnl 143) and S. congratulated Peacock on 2 May 1820 (L ii 192). He referred to Jane
Gryffydh as ‘of the mountains’ in his letter to Peacock of 12 July 1820 (L ii 212).
